package metrics

// Added to CloudNativePG's metrics package by build.sh (not CNPG code): runs the user queries the way
// createMetricsFromUserQueries does, with a plain *sql.DB opener instead of
// a *postgres.Instance, so the exposition comes from CNPG's own QueryRunner,
// mappings and client_golang.

import (
	"database/sql"
	"time"

	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"

	"github.com/Masterminds/semver/v3"
)

// Opener returns a connection pool to a database.
type Opener func(db string) (*sql.DB, error)

// Generate runs every query once and records the last-update timestamp.
func (q *QueriesCollector) Generate(open Opener, databases []string, isPrimary bool, version *semver.Version, now time.Time) {
	q.metricsMutex.Lock()
	defer q.metricsMutex.Unlock()
	q.errorUserQueriesGauge.Set(0)
	q.errorUserQueries.Reset()
	q.cacheHits.Set(0)
	q.cacheMiss.Set(1)
	var generated []prometheus.Metric
	for name, userQuery := range q.userQueries {
		runner := QueryRunner{
			namespace:      name,
			userQuery:      userQuery,
			columnMapping:  q.mappings[name],
			variableLabels: q.variableLabels[name],
		}
		if (userQuery.Primary || userQuery.Master) && !isPrimary { // wokeignore:rule=master
			continue
		}
		if userQuery.RunOnServer != "" {
			c, err := semver.NewConstraint(userQuery.RunOnServer)
			if err != nil {
				q.reportUserQueryErrorMetric(name)
				continue
			}
			if !c.Check(version) {
				continue
			}
		}
		targets := userQuery.TargetDatabases
		if len(targets) == 0 {
			targets = []string{q.defaultDBName}
		}
		all := q.expandTargetDatabases(targets, databases)
		for target := range all {
			db, err := open(target)
			if err != nil {
				q.reportUserQueryErrorMetric(name + ": " + err.Error())
				continue
			}
			computed, err := runner.computeMetrics(db)
			if err != nil {
				q.reportUserQueryErrorMetric(name + " on db " + target + ": " + err.Error())
			}
			generated = append(generated, computed...)
		}
	}
	q.computedMetrics = generated
	q.timeLastUpdated = now
	q.lastUpdateTimestamp.Set(float64(now.Unix()))
}
